id: title:aspicer:label the scout detail link to its skill

review.posthog_relevance: Changes accessibility and discoverability of the 'View skill' action in the Scout detail header, potentially improving usability for screen readers and users relying on button text.
review.reason: Replaced a button's aria-label with descriptive text and added visible button text while retaining the tooltip, improving accessibility and discoverability.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to accessibility and discoverability; no broader systemic or performance impact is demonstrated. The score is assigned based on the localized, bounded nature of the change rather than unverified adoption or wider reliability improvements.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 is supplied. No score assigned. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaced a button's `aria-label` with a descriptive text label and added a visible button text, while retaining the tooltip.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the accessibility and discoverability of the 'View skill' action in the Scout detail header, potentially improving usability for screen readers and users relying on button text.
